steps: Peel and dice Sweet potato into 1 cm cubes; peel and finely dice Onion; mince Garlic.
Rinse 180 g of Quinoa under cold water in a fine-mesh sieve.
Combine Quinoa and 360 ml of Water in a medium saucepan; bring to a boil, then cover and simmer for 15 minutes.
Heat Olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat; cook Onion and Garlic for 3 minutes until softened.
Add Sweet potato cubes; cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until edges begin to soften.
Stir in Ground cumin, Turmeric, and Sweet paprika; cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add Cooked lentils, Crushed tomatoes, and Coconut milk; stir to combine.
Simmer over medium-low heat for 8 to 10 minutes until Sweet potato is tender when pierced.
Spoon Quinoa into bowls and top with the lentil and Sweet potato mixture.
Serve warm. Refrigerate leftovers in an airtight container for up to 3 days.
